QuestInfo.name: Song of Your Heart
QuestInfo.0: Play a song of courage on the Music Box using the score Astilda gave you.
QuestInfo.1: Moonie loved your music! All of sudden, Mercedes, queen of the elves, appears!
QuestInfo.2: Mercedes, the queen of the elves, returns as your song flows from the Music Box.

0.0: Play the song on your heart?

1.0: What a beautiful melody! I've never heard that one before.

yes.0: Philius mentioned that we had a guest. I see you've been keeping my favorite kid happy. As queen, I thank you for your kindness.
